title: Chassis Geometry & Tool Locations: Prepositions of Place
description: Specify exact spatial positions of driveshafts, brake lines, calipers, and safety switches using prepositions of place.
learning_objectives: Use prepositions of place: under, inside, between, behind, above
Give clear spatial directions on the truck assembly line

questions.prompt: The driveshaft runs directly _____ the central protective backbone tube.

explanations.correct: The driveshaft is enclosed within the tube $\rightarrow$ 'inside'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Hnací hřídel běží uvnitř nosné roury'. Enclosed space uses 'inside'.

questions.prompt: The mechanic is working _____ the truck chassis on the service pit.

explanations.correct: Working beneath the vehicle $\rightarrow$ 'under the chassis'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Mechanik pracuje pod podvozkem'. Spatial position beneath $\rightarrow$ 'under'.

questions.prompt: The auxiliary gearbox is mounted _____ the front axle and the rear bogie.

explanations.wrong_B: 'among' is for three or more indistinct items.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'mezi přední nápravou a zadním podvozkem'. Two distinct reference points take 'between'.

questions.prompt: Store all pneumatic torque wrenches _____ the red steel tool cabinet.

explanations.wrong_B: 'on' means on top of the cabinet roof.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Uložte do skříně'. Enclosed storage uses 'in'.

questions.prompt: The emergency stop button is situated on the wall directly _____ the operator station.

explanations.correct: Positioned at the rear of the operator $\rightarrow$ 'behind'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'přímo za stanovištěm operátora'. Positioned at the rear $\rightarrow$ 'behind'.

questions.prompt: The fuel tank is secured _____ the right side of the central backbone tube.

explanations.correct: Mounted on an exterior surface or side $\rightarrow$ 'on the right side'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'na pravé straně'. English surface / side uses 'on the right side'.

questions.prompt: The exhaust silencer is installed _____ the front cab and the cargo body.

explanations.correct: Spatial position between two modules $\rightarrow$ 'between the cab and the body'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'behind' would omit the second reference point.

questions.prompt: Please place the calibrated torque certificate _____ the vehicle documentation folder.

explanations.correct: Placing documents into an enclosure $\rightarrow$ 'inside the folder'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'on' means on top of the cover.

questions.prompt: The overhead crane hovers 5 meters _____ the chassis assembly line.

explanations.correct: Higher vertical position without contact $\rightarrow$ 'above the line'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech '5 metrů nad linkou'. Vertical height without direct contact $\rightarrow$ 'above'.

questions.prompt: The brake fluid reservoir is located right _____ the master cylinder.

explanations.correct: Adjacent position $\rightarrow$ 'next to the master cylinder'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'hned vedle hlavního válce'. Adjacent position $\rightarrow$ 'next to'.
